problem_statement: A real nonstationary integrated Full Richards + active DIVDRA + prescribed-head-bottom interval is not scientifically qualifiable with the policies currently admitted for F-TB10. The existing external full-half route has no admitted generic nonzero production tolerance, while the normalized Richards certificate route requires explicit application/runtime accuracy-budget provenance that F-TB10 does not own.
required_owner_decisions: Define the intended application class for nonstationary standalone/integrated column qualification independently of direct groundwater coupling.

Choose and preregister the temporal acceptance semantic: retain external full-half with a newly qualified metric/tolerance, or use the normalized Richards head-budget certificate with explicitly governed budget provenance, or establish another qualified semantic.
If a numeric accuracy budget is required, define who owns it, how it is derived, its units, provenance and applicability bounds; no hidden/default value is allowed.
Demonstrate that hard mass rejection precedes any temporal acceptance and can never be overridden.
Qualify continuation/restart boundaries needed by the intended integrated cases rather than assuming no-history bootstrap.
Separate physical options from numerical policy and keep reference mode available.
Define bounded retry/cost behavior without making dt-monotonicity claims unless separately demonstrated.
Provide diagnostics sufficient to identify temporal rejection, mass rejection, nonlinear failure, retry and fallback use per interval.
minimum_qualification_matrix: nonstationary prescribed-head lower-boundary perturbation without drainage
active positive single-level DIVDRA with nonstationary prescribed-head lower boundary
at least one wetting/drying or forcing-change interaction from the F-TB09 catalog where the same policy is intended to apply
hard interval and full-window water balance
authorities_to_reuse: F-VQ28 negative authority for the existing universal full-half tolerance route
F-VQ34 and F-CI21 normalized Richards head-budget certificate semantics
F-CI44 application accuracy contract only where its QoI/application scope is actually applicable
F-CI46 external accuracy adapter only for already qualified external policy
F-CI36 frozen restricted DIVDRA owner authority
F-TB01 hard oracle hierarchy and mass policy
authorities_not_to_cross_scope: F-GC22 may inform design but is restricted to direct groundwater-head coupling and is not canonical at this handoff. It must not be treated as a standalone TB10 numeric budget authority.
F-VQ19 exact zero-tolerance fixture must not be generalized to arbitrary nonstationary Richards interactions.
forbidden_shortcuts: using interface head tolerance as temporal budget by equality assumption
compensating source/sink that removes the target physical interaction
production physics changes inside the testbank owner workunit
return_condition_to_F_TB10: Return only after a separately qualified and, where required, canonically admitted temporal policy/provenance explicitly covers the TB09-003 standalone/integrated runtime profile. F-TB10 may then be re-executed from a fresh qualified base without rewriting the closed F-TB09 catalog.
architecture_requirements: Explicitly audit all 30 SWAP core architecture invariants; invariants 7, 9, 13, 23, 24, 25, 26, 29 and 30 are directly implicated.
